scope: Exploratory measurements use different explicitly recorded baselines, warmup counts, sample counts and checker modes. They are not a single ranked benchmark.
interpretation: All exploratory batches monitored desktop input; their activity observations and original budget failures are preserved. The identical-binary control makes small tiered elapsed differences inconclusive; code-size reductions alone do not establish speedups.
